from pathlib import Path
programs=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792545996/attempts/5cf2b78706ee41199c1d98a935301463/system/state/workspace/programs')
programs.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
source='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        marks = {}
        for c, value in enumerate(row):
            if value not in (0, 8, 9):
                marks.setdefault(value, []).append(c)
        for color, cols in marks.items():
            for left, right in zip(cols, cols[1:]):
                if right - left == 2 and row[left + 1] in (0, 8, 9):
                    out[r][left + 1] = 2
    return out
'''
path=programs/'task-3b3cceae.py'
path.write_text(source)
exec(compile(source, str(path), 'exec'))
